p: A corporate planning team of three in navy business suits, two women and one man, standing around a large blank chart board with a simple rising line and a plain roadmap, together with a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face floating beside them.

A tired man in a navy suit at a desk surrounded by tall stacks of folders and blank papers, rubbing his forehead while searching through an open binder with a magnifying glass. A thought cloud with only a plain question shape.

A woman in a navy suit at a laptop writing a blank report page together with a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face, who holds a simple pen and points at the blank page. Several plain page outlines beside them.

A busy man in a navy suit hurriedly moving blank data from several plain paper sheets into a blank spreadsheet on a monitor, with piles of blank forms from different departments on the desk and a plain clock nearby without numbers.

Several blank sticky notes and simple feedback cards flying from small office workers on the left into one tidy blank list on a clipboard. A woman in a navy suit and a man in a light shirt discuss the list, with a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face sorting the cards.

A long simple process path made of connected plain rounded boxes on a large blank board, with one box highlighted in amber with a small stacked pile of waiting blank folders in front of it and a loop arrow. A man in a navy suit points to it with a magnifying glass.

A young woman in a navy suit receiving a blank request form from a colleague on the left; a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face hands her a blank report with small plain reference tabs and a magnifying glass over the pages. A globe icon and blank charts nearby without characters.

A senior woman in a navy suit at a table reviewing one blank strategy sheet with thoughtful expression; a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face sits opposite, showing a plain amber warning flag and plain question shapes pointing at gaps in a simple blank plan diagram. She keeps a hand on a plain decision stamp.

A plain boardroom table with blank slide pages being arranged into a neat stack. A man in a navy suit holds a blank bar chart page and checks it with a pen, while a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face offers a blank slide draft. A blank presentation screen behind them.

Several blank folders and blank spreadsheets from different plain department boxes flow along arrows into one neat blank report with a small check mark. A woman in a navy suit stands beside it holding an approval stamp with a check mark.

A simple blank project board with plain cards in columns and a plain timeline with one amber delayed bar. A man in a navy suit reads one blank one-page report given by a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face, a colleague woman beside him. No characters on the board.

A small team meeting at a table on the left with blank notes; a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face extracts plain task cards with a blank face icon and a blank calendar without numbers. A woman in a navy suit checks a card before it flows into a tidy blank task board.

A man in a navy suit at a desk looking at an open binder; a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face pulls one highlighted page from a neat tall shelf of old blank meeting records and folders, with a plain timeline of dots behind them leading to a small flag.

A woman in a navy suit and a man in a navy suit look at a blank dashboard on a big monitor with simple bar charts and a plain balance scale. On one side of the scale a plain clock without numbers, on the other a coin without characters. Blank clipboard with check marks beside them.
